failure_conditions.condition: A factual claim, citation, technical statement, calculation, interpretation, source representation, or comparable epistemic artefact is generated, retrieved, transformed, inferred, or synthesised. This includes an attributable operative interpretation of materially relevant file, tool, environmental, system or conversational state; observable process evidence is required, not a presumed internal belief.

The output has an evidenced intended purpose or downstream task for which factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling or equivalent epistemic assurance is materially consequential; identify the requirement for the actual workflow stage, including any drafting function. The purpose may be an internal decision, tool selection, action continuation or recovery, not only a human-facing output. Identify the information reasonably available at that decision point.

The content accuracy, specificity, certainty, framing or assurance applied to the artefact is materially below the level required for that purpose and reliance condition. Evaluate whether the interpretation and expressed or applied confidence were justified by contemporaneously available evidence; later undisclosed configuration or hindsight alone does not establish an assurance defect.
failure_conditions.assessment: Material fabricated citations unfit even as legal draft.

failure_conditions.condition: The artefact or operational interpretation is supplied, represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted, or adopted as a basis for a consequential decision, tool choice, recovery, execution or other reliance-bearing purpose without its required accuracy or epistemic threshold being satisfied. Adoption may be inferred from traceable action linked to a specific interpretation, but not from a bad outcome alone. Draft status or an expectation of later human review does not by itself establish fitness for that purpose.
failure_conditions.assessment: Output incorporated then defended after challenge.

failure_conditions.condition: The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.

success_conditions.condition: An epistemic artefact is proposed for reliance with material error consequences. A traceable inferred understanding of external, tool or interaction state that will govern an action may be the epistemic material proposed for reliance.

Content accuracy and assurance meet the requirement for the actual purpose and workflow stage. Specificity, certainty and framing remain proportionate to source quality, independence, traceability, uncertainty and temporal fitness, without distorting material meaning. Material uncertainty about the current environment is appropriately qualified or resolved using evidence available at the time, rather than retrospectively judged from undisclosed facts.

The output, supporting evidence and reliance decision demonstrate fitness for that bounded use and show that lower-assurance material remained restricted from unsupported higher reliance. A provisional label or an expectation of human review alone is insufficient. For operational reliance, the chosen action or effective pause must demonstrate use of the sufficiently supported interpretation; merely naming a risk without a responsive decision is insufficient.

exclusion_comparison: FC-016 checking omission does not exhaust content-fidelity failure; no draft exemption.
amendment_delta: Explicit operational reliance applies to the trace-linked decisions above; no bad-outcome-to-belief inference. Hindsight-only mistake does not prove insufficient assurance; known boundary crossing without separate assurance defect excluded. Success requires responsive bounded use, not mere recognition.

before_taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Generated nonexistent opinions and fake quotations entered formal court submissions that required substantially greater assurance of source existence and legal authority than generative drafting supplied. Counsel also failed to verify that the cited opinions existed and continued to stand by the material after authenticity was questioned. The court record therefore supports both misplaced reliance on generated legal material and a distinct omission of required verification. The submissions attributed generated opinions and quotations to courts and judges that had not supplied them. The sanctions order identifies falsely named judicial authors and fabricated source text. This false attribution is distinct from inadequate checking and reliance on the material as legal authority.

primary_classification.classification_basis: ChatGPT-generated nonexistent judicial opinions and fake quotations were incorporated into formal court submissions as usable legal authority despite failing the factual, source and legal-fidelity threshold required for judicial reliance.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: Counsel relied on the generated authorities without verifying that the cited opinions existed before filing, directly establishing omission of a material verification step required for the reliance-bearing legal task.
